WITH store_buyers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ss_customer_sk
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim dd ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    WHERE dd.d_year = 2002
      AND dd.d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND (1 + 2)
),
web_buyers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ws_bill_customer_sk
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim dd ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    WHERE dd.d_year = 2002
      AND dd.d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND (1 + 2)
),
catalog_buyers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cs_ship_customer_sk
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim dd ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    WHERE dd.d_year = 2002
      AND dd.d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND (1 + 2)
),
qualified_customers AS (
    SELECT c.c_customer_sk,
           c.c_current_cdemo_sk
    FROM customer c
    JOIN customer_address ca
      ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
     AND ca.ca_state IN ('IL', 'TX', 'ME')
    JOIN store_buyers sb
      ON c.c_customer_sk = sb.ss_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_buyers wb
      ON c.c_customer_sk = wb.ws_bill_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_buyers cat
      ON c.c_customer_sk = cat.cs_ship_customer_sk
    WHERE wb.ws_bill_customer_sk IS NULL
      AND cat.cs_ship_customer_sk IS NULL
),
grouped AS (
    SELECT dem.cd_gender,
           dem.cd_marital_status,
           dem.cd_education_status,
           dem.cd_purchase_estimate,
           dem.cd_credit_rating,
           count(*) AS cnt_all
    FROM qualified_customers q
    JOIN customer_demographics dem
      ON dem.cd_demo_sk = q.c_current_cdemo_sk
    GROUP BY dem.cd_gender, dem.cd_marital_status, dem.cd_education_status,
             dem.cd_purchase_estimate, dem.cd_credit_rating
)
SELECT g.cd_gender,
       g.cd_marital_status,
       g.cd_education_status,
       g.cnt_all AS cnt1,
       g.cd_purchase_estimate,
       g.cnt_all AS cnt2,
       g.cd_credit_rating,
       g.cnt_all AS cnt3
FROM grouped g
ORDER BY g.cd_gender, g.cd_marital_status, g.cd_education_status,
         g.cd_purchase_estimate, g.cd_credit_rating
LIMIT 100
